name: DECISION_V3_A_SOFT_VS_A_VACANCY_DIAGNOSIS_V1
purpose: Outcome-blind descriptive diagnosis of why Tier-A soft-replacement entrants were more durable than Tier-A vacancy-fill entrants in the frozen rejected Decision V3 replay.
frozen_questions: How do A_SOFT and A_VACANCY differ in current rank, previous rank, rank delta, and recent Top10/Top20 persistence at entry?
How do their entry sessions differ in pre-fill mandatory-exit stress and cross-sectional Top10/Top20 overlap?
Does the next-session severe-exit gap persist within fixed current-rank, previous-rank, persistence, and session-stress reporting strata?
Does the gap persist when restricted to severe-exit sessions only?
On sessions where both A_SOFT and A_VACANCY entries occur, does the durability gap persist within the identical session context?
Is eventual severe-exit incidence directionally consistent with the next-session structural result?
interpretation_guard: All comparisons are descriptive structural evidence on the already-observed frozen V3 trajectory. Reporting strata are not policy thresholds and no causal effect or successor rule is inferred automatically.
